title: Watch the Official Trailer for Anne Rice's Mayfair Witches: Salem Coven
summary: Watch the official trailer for the haunting new season of Mayfair, set in the infamous town of Salem, Massachusetts, premiering Wednesday, December 30 exclusively on AMC+ and AMC. Starring Alexandra Daddario, Harry Hamlin, Tongayi Chirisa, Eliza Scanlen, Alyssa Jirrels, Betsy Brandt, Michiel Huisman, James Frain and Omar Maskati.
body_markdown:
Salem is calling! AMC Global Media released today the official trailer for[Anne Rice’s Mayfair Witches: Salem Coven](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/mayfair-witches--1059404) starring Alexandra Daddario. Set in the infamous town of Salem, Massachusetts, where ancient magic collides with new witch bloodlines, the haunting new season continues the dark saga of the Mayfair family, as Rowan (Daddario) must wield her rising power to confront forces determined to control the fate of the witches.[Mayfair Witches: Salem Coven premieres Wednesday, December 30 at 9/8c exclusively on AMC+](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/mayfair-witches--1059404) **and**[AMC](https://www.amc.com/shows/mayfair-witches--1059404) .[Watch the trailer below](https://www.amc.com/shows/mayfair-witches/videos/mayfair-witches-salem-coven-trailer--1076420) :


Starring alongside Daddario are Harry Hamlin, Tongayi Chirisa, Eliza Scanlen, Alyssa Jirrels, Betsy Brandt, Michiel Huisman, James Frain and Omar Maskati. *Mayfair Witches: Salem Coven* is produced by AMC Studios and executive produced by award-winning producer Mark Johnson, who oversees the *Anne Rice Immortal Universe* for AMC Global Media, co-showrunners Esta Spalding and Thomas Schnauz, Michelle Ashford, Tom Williams, Christopher Rice and the late Anne Rice.
